post_meta.author: quietscope_r
post_meta.title: Sawmill Pass early season
post_meta.text: Sawmill 6/11. Continuous snow above the last switchbacks on the west side, firm crust at sunrise, no drama with spikes. East side melts fast, mostly dry below 10,000. Sawmill Creek crossing was knee high with a strong push at midday.

post_meta.author: graniteandpine
post_meta.title: Sawmill Pass loop
post_meta.text: Sawmill 7/21. Hot and dry on the east side climb, pass itself is clear, tiny patch on the west ramp you can avoid. Sawmill Creek is barely a step across now. Woods Creek below was moving but fine at the crossing. Nobody needs traction on this one anymore.
